title: About Me
paragraphs: Hello there! I'm Miguel R. Buccat — you can call me Migs! I am a Filipino Computer Science major currently studying at CIIT College of Innovation and Integrated Technology in Kamuning, Quezon City.

I am a curious mind with an unhealthy addiction to seeking out new things to learn — even beyond technology. I am most curious about the world around me, and the prospect of how technology can make it a better place for all.
I am a firm believer that skills and talents are better used, not to enrich oneself, but to enrich the lives of others.
